objective: Run the complete local validation loop for the new private C-Shop worker adapter against the pinned standalone C-Shop runtime. Fix concrete adapter defects if found, rerun the full relevant validation, and return one evidence-backed PASS/FAIL receipt. Do not merge or deploy.
security_boundary: Keep C-Shop loopback-only for this validation. Do not expose port 7333 publicly.
Do not touch the protected production branch feat/hermes-commerce-control-plane.
Do not modify Render, seller payment configuration, ledgers, wallets, signing state, or live-value settings.
Do not merge this feature branch.
The commerce adapter must not accept arbitrary raw scripts and must not emit C-Shop style commands in this first slice.
Use an isolated disposable C-Shop workspace for runtime tests.

execution.name: Synchronize the implementation branch
execution.pass: Working tree is clean and HEAD is the remote feature branch head.

execution.name: Run the complete adapter unit suite
execution.pass: All adapter tests pass under Node 24 or newer. If Node is older, use the existing project-supported Node 24 environment rather than weakening the package requirement.

execution.name: Prepare the pinned standalone C-Shop checkout
commands: if [ ! -d c-shop/.git ]; then git clone https://github.com/stubbb/c-shop.git c-shop; fi
execution.pass: The checkout is exactly pinned. Record the Rust/Cargo versions. If the installed Rust is too old, use rustup/current stable locally; do not edit C-Shop just to accommodate an obsolete compiler.

execution.name: Build and run upstream tests
execution.pass: Workspace tests and release build pass. If an environment-specific GPU/window test cannot run, preserve the exact command/error and distinguish an environment limitation from a code failure. Do not enter an architecture/replanning loop.

execution.name: Reproduce the three previously identified server questions
instructions: Inspect and runtime-test the pinned source for style loading relative to the Sandbox. Specifically trace find_style/cmd_style and determine whether a served script can cause style loading to read outside the configured workspace. Use only disposable canary files. Report CONFIRMED, NOT_REPRODUCED, or FIXED_UPSTREAM_AT_PIN with exact evidence.

Test session behavior both with an explicit Mcp-Session-Id and with that header omitted. Confirm that explicit sessions retain one document across calls. Record exactly what no-header calls do; do not assume the earlier classification is still correct.

GET / and GET /health while loopback-bound and record which workspace/session metadata is exposed without authorization. Then classify the practical risk under the adapter's loopback-only boundary. Do not bind publicly for this test.
execution.pass: Each question has a reproducible result and evidence. The adapter itself must remain safe even if the upstream behavior is unchanged: explicit session IDs, no style commands, loopback-only runtime.

execution.name: Run a real end-to-end graphics smoke job
commands: for i in $(seq 1 60); do curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:7333/health >/dev/null && break; sleep 1; done
execution.pass: The adapter completes a real MCP job, the report contains zero failed C-Shop steps, a preview is returned, and the full-size exported image exists and is non-empty.

execution.name: Fix only concrete adapter failures and rerun everything
instructions: If steps 2 or 6 expose an adapter defect, fix the complete coherent defect on feat/cshop-worker-adapter, then rerun the full adapter unit suite and the live smoke job.
If upstream C-Shop itself requires a code change, do not copy its source into agent-commerce-hub. Record the exact blocker and proposed separate-fork change instead.
Do not broaden scope into a public graphics API, product publication, Render deployment, or generalized graphics framework.
execution.pass: No known adapter failure remains after the final full validation.

execution.name: Return one closure receipt
instructions: Include: hub HEAD, C-Shop SHA, Node/Rust/Cargo versions, adapter test totals, cargo test totals, build result, the three server-question results with evidence, smoke report, output file size/type, any patches made, and a final CSHOP_WORKER_RUNTIME_VALIDATION=PASS or FAIL.
If code was changed, commit it together with the result and push feat/cshop-worker-adapter. Do not merge.
execution.pass: The result is self-contained enough for ChatGPT to fix a failure or close the validation without another discovery pass.

fallback: If native C-Shop cannot start solely because the local environment lacks the graphics/Vulkan runtime, preserve the exact native failure and make one bounded attempt using C-Shop's own pinned Docker setup if Docker is already available. Do not install a large new virtualization stack solely for this validation. If neither path is available, return FAIL_ENVIRONMENT with the exact blocker rather than looping.
stop_condition: Implementation complete + adapter tests pass + pinned C-Shop build/relevant tests pass (or explicitly bounded environment-only exclusions) + real MCP smoke export passes + three server questions are evidenced + no known adapter blocker = DONE.
